preconditions.description: Input must contain two integers n (3 ≤ n ≤ 1000) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 40), where n is the number of photos and m is the number of albums.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000 for x in stdin.split()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each album's photo count ai must satisfy 1 ≤ ai ≤ 1000.
The input must contain exactly m + 2 integers (n, m, followed by m album sizes).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= m for x in stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output must be exactly '-1'. Otherwise, output must be exactly n integers (1 ≤ ti ≤ m), representing the album numbers for each photo in the widget.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(stdout.split()[i] != stdout.split()[i-1] for i in range(1, n)) and all(stdout.split()[0] != stdout.split()[-1])
postconditions.description: For any valid solution, no two adjacent photos (including the first and last in the circular arrangement) can be from the same album.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(sum(1 for x in stdout.split() if x == str(i)) <= a[i-1] for i in range(1, m+1))
postconditions.description: For any valid solution, the number of photos selected from each album i does not exceed its available count ai.
